market_expectations.distribution_notes: RBA already hawkish; markets had been pricing a high probability of another hike, making labour composition important.

predictions.mechanism: Higher unemployment and weaker full-time employment reduce labour-market quality and may temper RBA tightening pressure, but the index remains dominated by high global yields and oil-driven inflation concerns.
predictions.invalidation: A sustained recovery above the pre-release/opening range with falling Australian/global yields would invalidate the residual downside bias.
predictions.counter_case: The +39.5K headline employment beat and higher participation show labour demand is not collapsing; if yields fall on the softer unemployment/full-time detail, equities could rebound.
